AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – CONDENSER

9. REMOVE LIQUID TUBE AND DISCHARGE TUBE
Torque: 10 N·m (100 kgf·cm, 7 ft·lbf)
REMOVAL NOTICE: Cap the open fittings immediately to keep moisture out of the system.
INSTALLATION HINT: Lubricate the new O–rings with compressor oil and install the tubes.

N08731

N08730

10. REMOVE CONDENSER
(a) Remove the radiator upper mounting.
(b) Push the radiator to engine side.

N08726

(c) Remove the condenser upper mounting.

N08727

(d) Push the condenser to engine side and remove the liquid tube piping clamp.
Torque: 4.1 N·m (42 kgf·cm, 36 in.·lbf)
